title: A test is skipped with no expiry: "no GNU tar here (macOS ships bsdtar

root_cause.mechanism: A skip with no expiry is a deleted test that nobody decided to delete: it never runs again and no one is told.

evidence: tests/test_hooks.py:1246 — skip marker with reason '"no GNU tar here (macOS ships bsdtar'; no date or expiry in the reason
found by a regular expression over the test files, not by a model

withdrawn by the skip scan 2026-11-27: it read tests/test_hooks.py again and files nothing at the cited lines, which are as they were — the same text no longer reads as a skip with no expiry, so the rule that filed this was wrong
narrative: The skip scan that filed this read the same lines again and no longer files them. The finding was a false positive of the rule as it then stood, and it stays on the record as one.
